messages:
mila: quick async standup — what I did: ran a capacity probe for GPU pools in us-west and eu-central, found APAC prewarm jobs running twice due to a race in the cron -> fixed the cron lock.

mila: blocker: one autoscaling group in eu-central is stuck terminating instances and it's holding on to ~8 GPUs, hitting our quota headroom. can't force-replace without infra approval. need a short guide if someone else has handled this.

sanjay: saw it, filing infra ticket TW-1123 now. you can attempt a graceful detach first: `aws autoscaling detach-instances --instance-ids i-0abc... --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-eu-central --should-decrement-desired-capacity false` — if that fails lemme know and I'll escalate. :+1:

opsbot: alert: spot-eviction-spike detected in us-west-2 at 03:14 UTC. evictions=12 over 5m, pressure=high. impacted-pools: gpu-usw-ash, gpu-usw-spot.

jin: thanks, flagging: if evictions persist we should fallback to reserved pool earlier. PR #483 has a small change to lower max batch size during high-eviction windows (won't change model quality). link: https://git.redwood/pr/483

leo: reviewed #483 — looks safe. one nit in the config comment, added suggestion. will approve once updated.

mila: noted, I'll merge after sanjay confirms the ASG ticket. also planning a manual drain of the stuck instances tonight at 22:00 UTC if approvals come through.

sanjay: TW-1123 created, pinged infra-approvals. ETA on review ~2h. if we don't have approval, ops team recommends temporary routing to dedicated-reserved in eu-central to free headroom.

mila: ok, I'll prepare a quick routing patch and a rollback playbook. small snippet for routing override I tested:
```json
{
  "policy": "region-prefer-reserved",
  "thresholds": {"spot_pressure": 0.6},
  "fallback": "gpu-eu-central-reserved"
}
```

jin: perfect. I'll also ensure the Optimize job disables batching > 8 for the routed pool (will push in the same deploy window).

mila: thanks — final note: can folks react with :eyes: when you see the ticket update? I'll post the playbook once approvals land.

leo: :eyes:

sanjay: :eyes:
